declare namespace u = "urn:einvoice-preflight:util";
declare function u:fmt($n as item()*, $pic as xs:string) as xs:string { if (empty($n)) then "NaN" else let $x := xs:double($n) return if ($x != $x) then "NaN" else let $c := xs:integer(round-half-to-even(abs($x) * 100)) return concat(if ($x < 0 and $c > 0) then "-" else "", if ($c idiv 100 > 0 or starts-with($pic, "0")) then string($c idiv 100) else "", ".", format-integer($c mod 100, "00")) };
